label: Fill Rate
description: Share of open opportunities filled in the period.

label: Internal Fill Rate
description: Share of filled opportunities filled by internal candidates.

label: Time to Fill (days)
description: Average days from opportunity open to fill.

label: Internal Mobility Rate
description: Share of workforce that moved internally in the period.

label: Ready-Now Coverage
description: Share of critical roles with at least one ready-now successor.

label: Post-Move Retention (12m)
description: Share of internal movers still in role 12 months post-move.

label: Promotion Rate
description: Share of workforce promoted in the period.

label: Cross-Function Move Rate
description: Share of internal moves that crossed functions.

label: High-Potential Coverage
description: Share of leadership pool identified as high-potential.

label: Capability Gap Index
description: Aggregate gap between required and observed capability across critical roles.

label: Match Score Distribution
description: Distribution of mobility match scores (median, p25, p75).

label: Opportunity Response Rate
description: Share of matched candidates who responded to outreach.
